Providence.text: At the Reaping: You may pay 1 Glory to exchange 1 face-up card on the Altar with 1 card from your Choir.
Providence.why: Four timing labels: In the Evening becomes At the Reaping (it now acts after the Tide is set)

Eternity.text: At the Reaping: You may take 1 card from the Altar into your hand.
Eternity.why: Four timing labels: In the Evening becomes At the Reaping (it now acts after the Tide is set)

Twilight.text: At the Reaping: If your Choir holds at least one Light and at least one Dark Host card, gain 1 Glory.
Twilight.why: Four timing labels: In the Evening becomes At the Reaping

Zealot.text: At the Reaping: If your Choir has the single most extreme net Alignment at the table (no ties), gain 1 Glory.
Zealot.why: Four timing labels: In the Evening becomes At the Reaping

Moderation.text: At the Reaping: If your Choir's Alignment is Neutral, gain 1 Glory.
Moderation.why: Four timing labels: In the Evening becomes At the Reaping

Remnant.text: At the Reaping: You may take 1 card from the Altar into your hand, then discard 1 card from your hand.
Remnant.why: Four timing labels: Before the Altar is Refreshed becomes At the Reaping (same moment)

Absolution.text: When a Host card is discarded from your Choir, you may return it to your hand instead, then discard 1 card from your hand.
Absolution.cadence: When a card leaves your Choir
Absolution.why: Four timing labels: Once per Day dropped (one turn per Day)

Mammon.text: When you Offer a Dark card, you may take its 1 Glory from a player of your choice instead of the Pot. When you Exalt, pay the Glory cost to the player, other than you, with the least Glory.
Mammon.why: Four timing labels: Once per Day dropped (one turn per Day)

Creation.text: In the Morning, reveal 3 Host cards from the deck onto the Altar.
Creation.why: No Seed (V41): Creation adds 3 cards instead of 3 Seeds

Pandemonium.text: First Fruits are placed facedown, and no card on the Altar may be flipped or looked at before the Evening.
